bullets.title: AI infrastructure selloff: worst week for AI basket since inception, semis down 8 sessions
bullets.body: The MSXXAIB AI Tech Beneficiaries basket fell -16.5% for the week—worst since launch—driven by CoreWeave (CRWV) debt concerns (CDS hit record 1,194 bps implying >60% default odds), Anthropic ARR disappointment, and Gartner's warning that $3.5T of AI infrastructure is at impairment risk by 2030. SOX fell 8 consecutive sessions (longest since May 2006, -11.4%), with the largest net TMT selling in years. The neocloud basket was down 23% on the week, though still up 55% YTD.

bullets.title: CRWV: JPM upgrades to OW; debt concerns 'overdone' on strong contract economics
bullets.body: JPMorgan upgraded CRWV to Overweight, arguing sell-off overdone: capacity is 100% pre-sold under take-or-pay contracts, unlevered IRR is mid-teens vs. 9-11% WACC, and GPU useful lives are extending beyond 6-year depreciation terms. NVDA CEO Jensen Huang publicly defended CoreWeave, stating cost of capital is 'decreasing.' However, CDS spreads hit record 1,194 bps and founders cashed $3.3B in shares, keeping sentiment fragile.

bullets.title: MSFT: Buy consensus strengthens; Azure 46-47% CC growth expected above 44-45% guide
bullets.body: Multiple houses raised MSFT price targets (Citi to $636, Mizuho to $600) ahead of Oct 28 earnings. CIO surveys show MSFT leading AI vendor preference at 30% of respondents. UBS remains constructive at 23x CY27. New Maia 300 chip announcement (40% more tokens/megawatt vs GPUs) and a 20-year NiSource power deal add to the bull case.

bullets.title: META: PT raised across the street on Muse Wonder launch; 3Q earnings Oct 21 key
bullets.body: BofA/Citi raised META to Buy/PT $800-$895 after Muse Wonder AI model launch matched frontier benchmarks. JPMorgan reiterated OW with $920 PT. Key debates: $10B legal accrual hits 3Q GAAP EPS; 2027 total expenses guided $210B+ (well above street $194B); Muse is now #1 on iOS App Store. Piper Sandler rates OW as primary focus for Oct 21 callback.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Cloud growth raised to +100% in 3Q on TPU monetization; earnings Oct 27
bullets.body: JPMorgan raised GOOGL Cloud growth estimates to +100% in 3Q26 and +107% in 2027 driven by TPU-as-a-service. Jefferies maintains Buy with $445 PT. Hedgeye signals bearish TREND on GOOGL Cloud's click-through rate decline as AI Overviews scale. Q4 needs +92% cloud consensus—a high bar. Gemini 4 Argon ranked #1 on Vals Index for finance/coding/legal, boosting near-term sentiment.

bullets.title: AMZN: Top internet pick heading into Oct 29 earnings; AWS bogey +42% YoY
bullets.body: JPMorgan names AMZN a top pick with Overweight/$365 PT. AWS growth modeled at +40% in 2027. Street is at +37% for 3Q, leaving room for a beat-and-raise. 3Q operating income expected ~$28B vs $26.5B guidance high. GPU reserve pricing up 15% on Oct 7. AMZN also reportedly in talks to acquire Decart AI for ~$7B.

bullets.title: NFLX: CCO replaced by ex-Disney Peter Rice; 3Q earnings Oct 20, ~8.9% implied move
bullets.body: Netflix replaced Chief Content Officer Bela Bajaria with Peter Rice (ex-FOXA/DIS) effective Oct 26, seen as acknowledgment of engagement concerns—stock fell 3.3% pre-market. Jefferies cut PT to $85 (Buy). Huber Research downgraded to Underweight with $70 PT. Consensus expects $0.82 EPS/$12.87B revenue; options imply ~8.9% move. Wolfe sees NFLX positioned for comeback on cost efficiency and NBCU acquisition synergies.

bullets.title: TSLA: MS turns more constructive post-Roadster; 3Q earnings ahead
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's Andrew Percoco turned more constructive on Tesla with a $400 PT, noting peak negativity has passed. The new Roadster with SpaceX thrusters (0-60 in 1 second, flying capability) generated +3.5% pre-market moves. Cybercab fleet now 300+ vehicles in Austin with 1M+ unsupervised miles. Hedgeye shifted TSLA from Bullish to Neutral on Oct 16.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone Duo preorders drive +2% pre-market; supply constraints push delivery to Jan 25
bullets.body: iPhone Duo preorders launched Oct 16 with delivery timelines slipping to Jan 25 on manufacturing constraints—seen as a strong demand signal. AAPL rose +2% pre-market. New HomeView smart display ($299) announced. JPM raised PT to $360 at 34x CY28 EPS. Separately, new CEO signaled memory shortage is a 'crisis' with 'all options on the table' for China chip sourcing.

bullets.title: TSM: Raised FY26 revenue guidance to +44%; 4Q guide $52.3-54.3B above consensus
bullets.body: TSMC beat 3Q with 66.4% gross margin and 4Q guide ~14% above consensus, raising FY26 growth to +44% (from +40%). N2 capacity to more than double in 2027. JPMorgan upgraded to Overweight with NT$3,300 PT (Jun-27) on 40%/28% revenue growth in 2027/28. AI accelerator CAGR expected above prior mid-high 50% guidance due to agentic AI driving incremental CPU/networking demand.

bullets.title: MU: IR call confirms supply/demand tightest in 2027-28; $33B buyback authorized
bullets.body: Micron's IR series call confirmed >75% of FY27 supply committed, with 35%+ of revenues through 2030 locked via long-term SCAs. HBM bit shipments grow faster than DRAM through 2028. New $33B share repurchase authorization (3x prior 2018 auth) effective Dec 9, with FCF expected significantly stronger in FY27. 22V flags a short setup under 890 with target 735.

bullets.title: TXN: UBS sees data center growing 73-75% YoY in CQ3/CQ4; 4Q guide likely above Street
bullets.body: UBS notes TXN data center exposure can grow 73-75% YoY in CQ3/CQ4. CQ4 guidance likely above Street at $5.8-5.9B. Wolfe hosted a webcast discussing TXN earnings power ahead of Oct 21 report. Street consensus is $2.42 EPS/$5.92B revenue. TXN is UBS's top pick in analog semis with positive pricing and improving auto cycle.

bullets.title: ACN: UBS upgrades to Buy ($278 PT); investor day confirms FY29 acceleration to mid-high single digits
bullets.body: UBS upgraded ACN to Buy with $278 PT after the investor day showed FY29 revenue growth accelerating to mid-to-high single digits (vs. mid-single digits in FY27-28), Network businesses expected to double to 12% of revenue, and $9B+ FY27 capital return. Mizuho and JPM both constructive. Emerging Alliances revenue tripled YoY; stock rallied ~25% post-Oct 1 earnings.

bullets.title: BKNG/EXPE/ABNB: Agentic AI threatens OTA commission pools; Hedgeye upgrades ABNB to Best Idea Long
bullets.body: Hedgeye upgraded ABNB to Best Idea Long ($190-220 target) on hotel push strategy and alt-accommodation moat. EXPE maintained as short bias on B2B sustainability and weak AI readiness. BKNG launched Vayo personal AI travel agent with $100M investment. OTA stocks down 15-25% since Meta Muse/Instinct launches enable browser-automated bookings that bypass OTA intermediaries entirely.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: BofA upgrades FOXA to Buy ($85 PT); Roku shareholders approve acquisition
bullets.body: BofA upgraded FOXA from underperform to buy, raising PT from $54 to $85 (33% upside) following Roku shareholders approving the acquisition. The deal is structured as $96 cash + 0.9693 FOXA shares per ROKU share at $160/share ($22B EV). DOJ second request extends review; close expected H1 2027. Fox expects ~$400M run-rate cost synergies.

bullets.title: NOW: Multiple houses constructive into earnings; 3Q CRPO expected ~200bps upside to guide
bullets.body: Piper raised NOW PT to $175; Citi raised to $170; Oppenheimer to $165; Mizuho to $170. Field checks indicate improving AI SKU adoption especially in federal cyber, stronger Security and ITOM demand, and no quarter-end pressure. The all-SaaS old guard (NOW/TEAM/CRM/WDAY/ADBE/INTU) outperformed SOX by ~18% this week. NOW denied interest in Decagon acquisition.

bullets.title: T: AT&T sells Mexico ops for $2B to Televisa/Fintech; Bernstein downgrades to Market Perform
bullets.body: AT&T agreed to sell AT&T Mexico to Grupo Televisa and Fintech Holdings for $2B cash, closing Q1 2027 at ~2.3x EV/EBITDA—viewed as surprisingly cheap. Bernstein downgraded T to Market Perform ($24 PT) citing SpaceX D2D wireless competitive pressure. MS reiterates OW on T, viewing the SpaceX selloff as overdone.

bullets.title: DKNG: NY OSB GGR -24% YoY week ending 10/11; Citi cuts EBITDA ests, PT to $28 on PM spend
bullets.body: New York OSB weekly GGR fell 24% YoY for week ending 10/11, with DKNG down 21% YoY (hold rate -610bps for FanDuel). Citi cut DKNG's 3Q/4Q EBITDA estimates by $50M/$70M on prediction market customer acquisition costs and PT to $28 (from $32 at 14x 2027 EBITDA). NFL Week 5 saw 4 of 5 biggest favorites win, creating additional hold headwind.

bullets.title: SHOP: Pricing increases 13-20% for new annual plans signal pricing power; CFO investor call Nov 5
bullets.body: Shopify raised Grow/Advanced tier prices ~13-20% in the US for new annual plans (Basic tier also raised ex-US). UBS estimates immaterial 2027 impact. JPM reiterates OW with $200 PT citing ~30% 2027 revenue growth path and agentic commerce upside. JPM hosting CFO Jeff Hoffmeister investor zoom Nov 5.

bullets.title: BE: AEP-Google 702MW fuel cell deal confirmed; Bloom Energy primary power source
bullets.body: American Electric Power announced a ~$4B investment in a 702MW fuel cell generation project near Cheyenne, Wyoming with Google as 20-year PPA counterparty, using Bloom Energy technology. Construction starts 2026, fully operational by end-2028. Roth maintains Neutral on BE but raised PT to $260; Opco notes the Schneider Electric triple-digit data center growth read-through is positive for BE/VRT/GEV.
